## Summary

I work best on end-to-end product problems: architecture, infrastructure, front end, backend services, testing, deployment, and the messy delivery work around them. I am optimizing for teams that value technical depth, calm execution, and someone who can move from messy requirements to shipped software without waiting for perfect conditions.

## Source of Truth

This portfolio is maintained from a career source-of-truth vault with canonical role notes, project proof, skills evidence, profile drafts, and cleanup/review logs. Public copy stays short, but the claims underneath are tracked.

- Claims trace back to source notes, live-profile reviews, project records, or explicit user-confirmed facts.
- Toptal verification is surfaced through the public Top 3% Talent badge and linked resume.
- Public-facing text stays separate from raw/private material like rates, earnings, and internal source captures.
- The career vault has a review cadence, templates, cleanup policy, and a local wiki checker for frontmatter, links, and boundary warnings.

## Values

- **Own the full product slice:** My highest-value work is end-to-end — architecture, infrastructure, front end, back end, testing, and shipping.
- **Be the rescue engineer when it matters:** Comfortable walking into unfamiliar code under time pressure and turning it back into a working delivery lane.
- **Build with constraints:** Bootstrapped startup work, solo builds, and client delivery taught me to move with the conditions in front of me.
- **Keep curiosity alive:** I build some things because they should exist, and some things because I want to learn how they work.

## Current Focus

Shipping end-to-end product work while staying close to AI tooling, side projects, and game-engine experiments. Best fit: senior, staff, or founding-engineer roles where one person needs to own the vertical slice and keep momentum high.

Current public side work: whichmodel, souk-fighter, and ongoing 3D graphics exploration.

The interactive terminal exposes this maintenance layer through `cat source`.
